body: TRIAGE: the numerical-policy question is not new. Current main already records the accepted split in docs/adr/0001-embedding-contract-and-hard-gate.md lines 314-315 and codec/README.md lines 34-38: decode/re-encode of one artifact is byte-exact; separately rerunning transcendental inference across numeric runtimes does not promise identical bits; Native low-order libm drift is explicit. The fresh v4 observation is valuable version-bound evidence, but it should not trigger a futile bit-identity repair, libm pin, or tolerance weakening unless exact-stage localization contradicts the established explanation. The new actionable defect is documentation/version drift: current codec code declares SchemaVersion hsmm/v3, while the README table and portability paragraph and ADR field list still say hsmm/v1; the proposed successor declares hsmm/v4 and its public handoff does not name these docs paths. Thus consumers cannot tell which schema the published portability statement governs. Proposed bounded follow-up: update the versioned wire field list/current-schema references and golden wording through v4 while preserving the already ruled platform contract; retain the two exact v4 bit differences and runtime identities as a receipt. No candidate source inspected and no support-slice widening inferred.
